_description: Moves the table-cell shortcuts off Ctrl+Alt+arrow, which JAWS, NVDA and Magnifier all claim for their own table navigation. Everything else is the QUILL Default layout.
_comment: Six bindings, and they are the only six that were ever needed: the previous 168-entry snapshot claimed to remap screen-reader conflicts and in fact differed from the default profile in nothing at all (bad.md P2.6). A chord a screen reader eats never reaches QUILL, so the command simply never fires.
